spec.description:
Autex Vicinity Desk Screen - Slate is a lightweight, semi-rigid acoustic
workstation screen crafted from 100% polyester fibre. Designed to be fixed
non-destructively to desks using Vicinity Workstation Clamps, the Slate design
features a clean rectangular shape with chamfered or rounded corner details that
enhance both visual and acoustic privacy. It absorbs speech-range frequencies
right where open-plan chatter starts, delivering acoustic sanctuary for focused,
independent work.
features:
Lightweight, semi-rigid 12mm or 24mm 100%
polyester acoustic screen

Slate design provides focused desk-level privacy
with clean, tailored lines

Constructed with a minimum of 80% post-consumer
recycled PET

Acoustic rating of 0.5 metric Sabins per unit (800mm Slate
screen)

Non-destructive fixing via Vicinity Workstation Clamps made from 100%
recycled PET

Group 1 fire rating compliant with AS ISO 9705 - 2003 and
AS 5637.1

Durable, pin-receptive, moisture-resistant, and will not slump or
fray over time

Safe, non-toxic, non-allergenic, and free of chemical binders
or formaldehyde

Certified Carbon Neutral product with third-party verified
EPD and Declare Red List Free

Available in over 20 solid Cube colours and
printed finishes

install:
Inspect the desk edge to confirm
thickness is compatible with Vicinity Workstation Clamps

Position the clamps
along the desk edge at recommended spacing (typically 150-200mm in from outer
edges)

Tighten the clamp thumb-screws or hex bolts securely to the desk
underside without overtightening

Insert the 12mm or 24mm Vicinity Slate
screen into the clamp jaws

Ensure the screen sits level and is properly
seated down into the bottom of each clamp channel

Tighten the screen
retaining screws on the clamp to firmly secure the acoustic screen in place
selection_checklist:

compatibility

Choose Slate width
and height for desired level of visual and acoustic separation

Select
colourway from Autex Cube palette

Confirm clamp quantity and finish (black or
white 100% recycled PET clamps)

limitations:

floor-standing or outdoor use

Non-structural screen; cannot support heavy
monitor arms or mounted shelving

Avoid direct exposure to liquids or
high-humidity environments

retrieval.rag_summary:
Autex Vicinity -
Desk Screen - Slate is a lightweight acoustic workstation partition made
from 12mm or 24mm Cube semi-rigid polyester felt containing at least 80%
recycled PET. Specifically shaped in the tailored Slate profile, it fixes
non-destructively to desktops via 100% recycled PET Vicinity clamps to absorb
voice frequencies (0.50 Sabins per 800mm unit) right where open-plan chatter
starts. Rated Group 1 fire compliant under AS ISO 9705 and certified carbon
neutral, it provides durable, pinnable acoustic and visual shelter for modern
agile offices.
